must_not: A lost saved data, a double saved data after the retry, or a success message for a save that failed

note: The admin app's offline keeper skips these pages on purpose, so with no internet they do not open from the installed app

start: Admin app, Settings, link Privacy notice; set-up: language

steps.action: Change the language setting, then do "Company and legal pages".
user_sees: Every word of the journey in the chosen language
must_not: Mixed languages on one screen, a raw text key, or a saved data that changes meaning

steps.action: Tap the link; the page /privacy.html opens
user_sees: Section '4. What we collect, and why'
Section '6. How long we keep it'
Top line of links: Privacy notice · Terms · Data agreement · Refunds · Shipping and delivery · Contact · About · Delete your account
must_not: A blank page or the admin app opening instead of the page
A section heading with no text under it

steps.action: Scroll to the bottom
user_sees: The email contact@mettleup.fit as a link
must_not: The page cut off before the Last updated line
An email address that cannot be tapped
Mixed languages on one screen, a raw text key, or a saved data that changes meaning

note: The app set to Hinglish opens English pages; only the privacy notice has a Hindi part
